description: This file defines a React component named CompactReasonersStats that displays real-time statistics about reasoning nodes, including online/offline counts, total nodes, last refresh time, and a refresh button. It uses various imported icons and UI components to structure and style the display.

methods.name: formatRelativeTime
methods.description: Formats the timestamp into a relative time string (e.g., '5m', '2h', '3d', or 'now').

methods.name: formatLastRefresh
methods.description: Formats the last refresh timestamp into a human-readable time string (e.g., '3:15:30 PM').
